items.title: Formula, Vol. 1
items.description: Fórmula, Vol. 1 is the debut studio album by American singer Romeo Santos, released on November 8, 2011, by Sony Music Latin. It is Santos's first album as a solo artist following the break-up of American bachata group Aventura, of which he was the lead singer. items.title: 2026 Kraków shooting
items.description: On 7 November 2026, a mass shooting occurred at the Main Square in Kraków, Poland. A gunman armed with an AR-15–style rifle opened fire from his car as he drove through the Main Square, killing at least six people and injuring more than sixteen others, before being shot and wounded by police during a shootout. items.title: 2026 Paraguay banking crisis
items.description: An ongoing economic, financial, and political crisis in Paraguay was triggered by the regulatory intervention and shutdown of Ueno Bank, the country's largest digital financial institution. The lender's collapse froze the liquid balances of approximately three million retail depositors and endangered more than US$800 million in public and pension funds.

items.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi
items.description: The Louvre Abu Dhabi is an art museum located on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It runs under an agreement between the UAE and France, signed in March 2007, that allows it to use the Louvre's name until 2047, and has been described by the Louvre as "France's largest cultural project abroad."
